title: DarkUnbug NaN fix
description: This will resolve player data issues where HP and Absorption get stuck with NaN values.
body:
This mod was created for the [DarkRPG](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/darkrpg) modpack but can be used on its own. It is a fork of the [Allow Editing Player Data](https://modrinth.com/mod/allow-editing-player-data) mod and now includes the trigger function to allow players to resolve their broken HP and Absorption NaN status without asking server admins.

This issue happens in large modpack servers where the HP and Absorption entries get broken with a set NaN status and the player is forever in a death glitch state.

![Screenshot 2025-11-29 193625.png](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1408/172/screenshot-2025-11-29-193625-png.png)

To use, simply type the command **_/trigger darkunbug_** which will then fix and reset your HP and Absorption

Example of player stuck in death glitch state on DarkRPG Fabric modpack using Hexblade origin

![2025-11-29_19.18.05.png](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1408/169/2025-11-29_19-18-05-png.png)

Use the command

![Screenshot 2025-11-29 193432.png](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1408/170/screenshot-2025-11-29-193432-png.png)

It will kill your character and reset your stats.

![Screenshot 2025-11-29 195344.png](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1408/176/screenshot-2025-11-29-195344-png.png)
